text:
**Summary of Work So Far:**

**Done:**
- Read entire `parse.py` (1318 lines) and `test_parse.py` (~973+ lines)
- Ran existing tests — all 74 pass successfully

**Pending Requirements:**
1. **[R1]** Add `'letters'` format specifier — matches only alphabetic chars (a-z, A-Z), unlike `'w'` which also matches `_` and digits
2. **[R2]** Add `__contains__` method to `Result` class to check if a value exists in parsed results
3. **[R3]** Validate brace enclosure — parts with braces must have matching braces, else raise error/fail
4. **[R4]** Fix `FixedTzOffset` timezone offset parsing (Bug 92) — likely related to offset calculation
5. **[R5]** Support Fortran-formatted floating-point numbers (e.g., `1H2.0` style or similar)
6. **[R6]** Improve hex/binary/octal integer conversion with optional base args and auto-detection
7. **[R7]** Replace lambdas/inner functions with picklable functors in conversion mechanisms
8. **[R8]** Make `findall()` honor `case_sensitive` parameter (currently creates new Parser without it)
9. **[R9]** Left/center-aligned searches consume up to next space character
10. **[R10]** Allow slice access on `Result` instances (e.g., `result[1:3]`)

**Next Steps:**
- Modify `ALLOWED_TYPES` to include `'letters'`
- Implement each requirement systematically
- Run existing tests after changes to ensure nothing breaks
- Write STATUS.json when complete
